description: Revoke certificates on the CA with puppetserver ca revoke, or with clean=true revoke them and delete them from the CA with puppetserver ca clean. Reports each certname as revoked, already_revoked, not_signed (only a request exists) or not_found, and whether the CRL changed. Refuses the certname of the host it runs on, the CA server. The server applies the revocation within a second; a compiler does once its copy of the CRL is replaced (ovadm::crl_install)

clean.description: Also delete the certificate, or a pending request, from the CA, so the certname can be enrolled again (default: false)
